tools.name: get_schema
tools.title: Get the agent read-layer contract
tools.description: Return the versioned agent read-layer contract: views, fields, PII flags and schema_version. Read-only and stable across releases.

tools.name: query_players
tools.title: Query player snapshots
tools.description: Query player snapshots from agent_player_snapshot with exact job/gang filters, an updated_since window, whitelisted fields and ordering. Maximum 200 rows.

fields.description: Comma-separated whitelist; omit for all snapshot fields.

tools.name: get_player_snapshot
tools.title: Get one player snapshot
tools.description: Return cash/bank/crypto, job, gang and PII-flagged display names for one citizenid. Read-only.

citizenid.description: QBCore citizen id (1-11 letters, digits, underscore or dash).

tools.name: get_player_timeline
tools.title: Get one player timeline
tools.description: Read the player timeline (quests, story choices, bank statements) for one citizenid, newest first, with an optional since filter.

citizenid.description: QBCore citizen id (1-11 letters, digits, underscore or dash).

tools.name: list_events
tools.title: List the agent event feed
tools.description: Read the append-only agent_events_feed ordered by id. Use since_id for cursor pagination; type may be exact or a prefix ending in *.

since_id.description: Return events with id greater than this cursor.

tools.name: get_world_digest
tools.title: Get the budgeted world digest
tools.description: Return a compact world digest: player/online estimate, top event types, recent important events, economy totals and cheap risk hints, fitted to budget_tokens.

tools.name: get_world_state
tools.title: Get world state rows
tools.description: Return world_state rows plus one summary row per world event type. Read-only observation of the world atmosphere and flags.

tools.name: get_economy_metrics
tools.title: Get economy metrics
tools.description: Return per-job aggregates from agent_economy_metrics: player counts and cash/bank totals. Read-only.

tools.name: get_live_players
tools.title: List live online players
tools.description: Read the live player roster: sampled positions, vitals, job and vehicle for online players, optionally filtered by job. Read-only and bounded to 48 rows.

tools.name: get_live_player
tools.title: Get one live player
tools.description: Read the live state of one online player by citizenid: sampled position, vitals, job, vehicle and session. Read-only; use get_live_players to discover ids.

citizenid.description: QBCore citizen id (1-11 letters, digits, underscore or dash).

tools.name: list_live_events
tools.title: List live game events
tools.description: Read the live event ring buffer since an epoch:seq cursor, oldest first, with a bounded limit. Read-only and best-effort; dropped events are reported.

tools.name: get_action
tools.title: Get one agent action
tools.description: Read one action row owned by this agent (proposal, approval state, preview and result). Read-only; used to verify a write after it was submitted.

action_id.description: Numeric agent_actions id returned by a write.

tools.name: list_actions
tools.title: List this agent's actions
tools.description: List actions previously proposed by this agent, newest first, optionally filtered by status. Read-only; the director filters by X-Agent-Id.

tools.name: send_notify
tools.title: Send a notification to one player
tools.description: Show a short plain-text notification to one online player. Text is display-only; it is never an event, command or script.

citizenid.description: QBCore citizen id (1-11 letters, digits, underscore or dash).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied idempotency key; derived when omitted.

tools.name: add_player_money
tools.title: Add money to a player (L4, approval required)
tools.description: Propose a capped, budgeted money grant. Always requires human approval; verify by re-reading the balance delta.

citizenid.description: QBCore citizen id (1-11 letters, digits, underscore or dash).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied idempotency key; derived when omitted.

tools.name: start_player_quest
tools.title: Start a quest for one player (L3, approval required)
tools.description: Propose starting a catalog quest for one player. Always requires human approval; quest_id must exist in the live quest catalog.

citizenid.description: QBCore citizen id (1-11 letters, digits, underscore or dash).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied idempotency key; derived when omitted.

tools.name: send_announce
tools.title: Broadcast a world announcement (L2, approval required)
tools.description: Propose a plain-text announcement to all players. World-scoped and reversible in the sense that it has no persistent state, but it still needs approval.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied idempotency key; derived when omitted.

tools.name: set_weather
tools.title: Set the world weather (L2, approval required)
tools.description: Propose changing the global weather. Reversible through a recorded before-value; always requires approval in v1.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied idempotency key; derived when omitted.

tools.name: set_time_of_day
tools.title: Set the world time of day (L2, approval required)
tools.description: Propose changing the global clock. Reversible through a recorded before-value; always requires approval in v1.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied idempotency key; derived when omitted.

tools.name: set_player_job
tools.title: Set a player's job (L3, approval required)
tools.description: Propose changing one player's job and grade. Always requires human approval; the previous job and grade are recorded for undo.

citizenid.description: QBCore citizen id (1-11 letters, digits, underscore or dash).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied idempotency key; derived when omitted.

tools.name: teleport_player
tools.title: Teleport one player (L3, approval required)
tools.description: Propose moving one player to explicit coordinates. Always requires human approval; the previous position is recorded for undo.

citizenid.description: QBCore citizen id (1-11 letters, digits, underscore or dash).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied idempotency key; derived when omitted.

tools.name: spawn_vehicle
tools.title: Spawn a vehicle (L3, approval required)
tools.description: Propose spawning a vehicle for one player. Always requires human approval; v1 has no safe delete tool, so removal is a manual operator action.

citizenid.description: QBCore citizen id (1-11 letters, digits, underscore or dash).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied idempotency key; derived when omitted.

tools.name: grant_player_item
tools.title: Grant an item to one player (L4, approval required)
tools.description: Propose granting a catalog item to one player. Always requires human approval and is not automatically reversible; compensation is manual.

citizenid.description: QBCore citizen id (1-11 letters, digits, underscore or dash).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied idempotency key; derived when omitted.

tools.name: remove_player_item
tools.title: Remove an item from one player (L4, approval required)
tools.description: Propose removing a catalog item from one player. Always requires human approval; compensation is manual.

citizenid.description: QBCore citizen id (1-11 letters, digits, underscore or dash).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied idempotency key; derived when omitted.

tools.name: set_player_bucket
tools.title: Move one player to a routing bucket (L3, approval required)
tools.description: Propose moving one player to a routing bucket. Session-scoped: it does not survive a reconnect. Human approval required.

citizenid.description: QBCore citizen id (1-11 letters, digits, underscore or dash).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied idempotency key; derived when omitted.

tools.name: kick_player
tools.title: Kick one player (L4, approval required)
tools.description: Propose kicking one online player with a reason. Irreversible; compensation is manual and means re-inviting the player.

citizenid.description: QBCore citizen id (1-11 letters, digits, underscore or dash).

reason.description: Shown to the player and written to the audit row.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied idempotency key; derived when omitted.

tools.name: revive_player
tools.title: Revive one player (L3, approval required)
tools.description: Propose reviving one online player. Clears isdead/inlaststand on the server and asks qb-ambulancejob to revive the client. Human approval required.

citizenid.description: QBCore citizen id (1-11 letters, digits, underscore or dash).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied idempotency key; derived when omitted.

tools.name: remove_player_vehicle
tools.title: Remove the vehicle a player is in (L4, approval)
tools.description: Propose deleting the vehicle the target player is currently in. Only the current vehicle can be targeted, never an arbitrary entity id. Irreversible; compensation is manual (respawn from a garage).

citizenid.description: QBCore citizen id (1-11 letters, digits, underscore or dash).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied idempotency key; derived when omitted.

tools.name: set_job_duty
tools.title: Set a player on or off duty (L2, approval)
tools.description: Propose toggling on-duty state for one player. Reversible by calling again. Human approval required.

citizenid.description: QBCore citizen id (1-11 letters, digits, underscore or dash).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied idempotency key; derived when omitted.

tools.name: set_player_metadata
tools.title: Set hunger/thirst/stress/armor (L3, approval)
tools.description: Propose setting one whitelisted metadata value (hunger, thirst, stress, armor) for one player. Death/handcuff flags are deliberately excluded. Human approval required.

citizenid.description: QBCore citizen id (1-11 letters, digits, underscore or dash).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied idempotency key; derived when omitted.

tools.name: send_phone_message
tools.title: Send a phone message to one player (L2)
tools.description: Propose a system SMS to one player. The sender is a server-side label; the recipient phone number is resolved server-side and never appears in the audit row. Human approval required.

citizenid.description: QBCore citizen id (1-11 letters, digits, underscore or dash).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied idempotency key; derived when omitted.
